ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels with approximately 25-35% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution concentrated at the distal tips and lateral margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity (white) zone on the distal portion of the right lobe; heterogeneous high-intensity mottling across the distal and mid-section of the left lobe; dominant low-intensity (black) field across the central and proximal regions near the peduncle.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch; central depression measured at approximately a 50-degree internal angle with a well-defined vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire visible boundary; pixel-amplitude of peaks varies between 5-20 pixels; significant jaggedness with distinct 'sawtooth' morphology on the upper quadrants of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primarily convex curvature along the trailing edges tapering to sharp, pointed distal tips; symmetrical outward sweep from the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Scattered circular high-intensity (white) pixel clusters, approximately 3-10 pixels in diameter, localized in the lower-central region of the left lobe and the dark field of the right lobe, consistent with barnacle scar footprints.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical and diagonal linear disruptions (rake marks) crossing the low-intensity regions of both lobes, particularly concentrated in the central-right dark field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular serration and deep notches along the trailing edge indicative of environmental wear or predation; specific large-scale indentation on the right lobe's upper margin.
